{{Quote|How do you change the past?''"<br />"''Simple. By changing the way you remember it.''"<br />"''Yeah, I suppose I could get my memory wiped.''"<br />"''Another whiskey and you'd be well on your way.|Han Solo, exchanging words with the bartender while drinking at the Lady Fate Casino|<ref name="AOCII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>}}
'''Whiskey''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. It was classified as a type of [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]].<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]'', chapter thirteen</ref> There were several types of whiskey available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] had, for all intents and purposes, sewn up the galaxy's whiskey market, both on the manufacturing and consumption sides.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
